name: MANKY VR
summary: Manky is a VR horror game by Constellation LLC, using gorilla locomotion to explore a chilling research facility. As a player, you’ll uncover secrets, collect research on escaped test subjects, and analyze their disturbing behavior. The game features a vast number of unique, interactable items throughout the facility, each offering clues and adding depth to the story.
